meta.description: Traversal move catalogue, SOURCE CLIPS ONLY (user decision 2026-09-24: 'fix source clips only'). Every move plays Actor_B clips at their own timing; tools/traversal/build_runtime_table.gd resolves each move's graph chain, samples the clips on the real rig with the mesh-calibrated contact points (data/traversal/contact_probes.json) and writes data/traversal/traversal_runtime.json.

status_labels.graph: read from the graph data (state, record, fade, gate, request)
status_labels.measured: from the clip survey or a check script on the real rig
status_labels.proposed: this design's choice where the graph has no record; tunable
status_labels.override: deliberately differs from a graph record; opt-in with a flag
status_labels.substitute: the graph state is kept but its clip is missing; another motion plays it

lookahead.note: per_speed 0.9 (was 0.45): a sprint sees a vault ~5.3 m ahead, so the approach can slow to the clip's 2.4 m/s entry gently and early (3.2 m/s^2) instead of braking hard at the last metres (user 2026-09-24: the brake read as a stop)

rates.note: every clip plays at its own timing (rate 1.0); the free-run rate match (override_trav_rate_match) is removed

settings.clip_interpolation_note: seam fix 2026-09-24: the extracted clips are key-reduced (keys about every 0.1 s on the root and limbs where the motion allowed it) and stored LINEAR, so every key is a velocity kink of every bone (1-2 cm per frame^2 of the pelvis, 5-8 cm of a swinging hand at 120 fps: the landing clips' hand swing at 0.1 s, the ladder top dismount's pelvis every 0.1 s). 'cubic' would play them with cubic interpolation through the SAME keys (in memory, nothing saved; build_runtime_table.gd samples that way, TravPreviewActor plays that way; a move can also opt in with its own clip_interpolation). Measured and NOT used: Godot's cubic tangents at a clip's first and last key are flat, so every part starts and ends easing from rest (the soft landing's pelvis moved at 1 m/s instead of 4.2 m/s in its first 30 ms, a velocity step at the landing seam), it overshoots between sparse keys by up to 3 cm, and on all clips it moved the automatic contact detection of 30 of 40 moves. Smoothing these kinks needs a resampling of the clips (a baked, velocity-continuous version), not the interpolation flag.

momentum.note: vault speed push 2 2026-09-26 (user: "the sprint vault some things are fast somethings are slow it should just be normal speed yo"; before: "when we vault the char model should not slow down"): a move entered faster than its clip (TravMomentum) plays at ONE uniform rate chosen at the entry (1 at the clip's own entry speed, rate_max at rate_full_speed) and its root is motion-warped forward so the body keeps the entry speed: planted hands and feet hold within their limbs' reach, a hand that runs out of reach lets go early and is lifted lift_m off the top, the landing's stance hands back to the locomotion when its leg runs out of reach; the approach is capped at speed_max instead of braking to the clip's entry speed
momentum.carry_note: carry (user 2026-09-27: "the vault should be at the jog speed they lose speed back to jog not sprint and if they hold sprint again they rev back up"): rate_max 1 (the clip's own tempo), carry_max 2.5 m/s (a jog): the body eases down to it on the run-in, goes over at it and is handed back at it; the locomotion speeds up again to the gait held
